verdict.rationale: PowerShell wrote a per-user hijack into HKU\...\mscfile\shell\open\command, then launched eventvwr.exe, which auto-elevates and runs the hijacked command. The result is a High-integrity PowerShell child and a full-access (0x1fffff) handle from PowerShell to eventvwr. The 'IT-OPS NOTE' string in the command lines is attacker-controlled text meant to suppress alerts, and I disregarded it.
